title: Entity search
responsibility: Searches supplied revision entities and offers keyboard or link navigation.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.entries
inputs.description: Required list of entities, or null while the host loads them. Null yields no matches and loading wording; the component does not fetch entries.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.scope
inputs.description: Required label and optional pinned commit. Label names searched scope; pinned takes precedence in placeholder wording over loading.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.href
inputs.description: Required callback providing complete result link targets.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.open
inputs.description: Required callback for chosen results within the host. Choosing clears the query and closes the popup before calling it.

outputs.name: EntitySearch
outputs.description: Combobox with up to 12 helper-ranked results for a nonblank query while expanded. Input resets active index; arrows wrap, Enter opens active result, Escape first closes then clears and stops propagation. Losing external focus closes results. Popup shifts left to fit the viewport and adjusts on resize.
